# oriz Color

Color studio — a museum of color at https://color.oriz.in

Pick, convert, harmonize, gradient, check contrast, and lift a palette straight out of any image. Big swatches, honest numbers, oklch-smooth blends. Everything runs in your browser — nothing is uploaded, nothing is stored on a server, and no signup is required.

100% client-side. No upload, no signup, no server. Images never leave your device — extraction runs on a local canvas. AI palette suggestions are optional polish; the core tools work with AI fully offline.

## Pick + Convert

Native color picker with live conversion across hex, rgb, hsl, and oklch. Copy any format with one click. The picker uses the OS-native color chooser, and every representation updates in sync as you move — so you can read the same color as `#1a56ff`, `rgb(26, 86, 255)`, `hsl(228, 100%, 55%)`, or `oklch(...)` at once.

## Palettes

Generate color-harmony schemes from any base color:

- Complementary
- Analogous
- Triadic
- Tetradic
- Split-complementary
- Monochromatic
- Shades
- A tint/shade ramp (light-to-dark steps)

Optional AI mode: describe a brand or mood in words and get a suggested palette. AI is optional polish — every harmony scheme is computed locally with color math and works with AI turned off.

## Gradient

Multi-stop gradient builder:

- Add and reposition multiple color stops
- Angle control for linear gradients
- Interpolate in oklch, oklab, hsl, or srgb color spaces (oklch gives the smoothest, most perceptually even blends)
- Export ready-to-paste CSS
- Read sampled stops along the gradient

## Contrast

WCAG 2.1 contrast checker:

- Computes the contrast ratio between a foreground and background color
- Reports AA and AAA passes for normal text and large text
- Reports the UI 3:1 pass for non-text/interactive elements
- Live text preview on the chosen background
- One-click swap of foreground and background

## Extract

Pull a palette out of any image:

- Drag-and-drop or pick an image file
- Choose how many dominant colors to quantize (3 to 12)
- Copy any extracted color in your preferred format

Extraction runs entirely on a local HTML canvas in your browser. Images are never uploaded — they never leave your device.

## How it works

oriz Color is a static site with interactive React islands. Color math is powered by the culori library. The optional AI palette feature uses g4f (GPT4Free) directly from the browser through the shared `@chirag127/oz-ai` package, so there is no API key and no server round-trip you control. Heavy libraries are lazy-imported only when a feature is actually used, keeping the initial load light.

The app is a PWA — installable to your device and usable offline for the core (non-AI) tools.

## FAQ

Is it free? Yes. Free, no signup, no account.

Are my images uploaded? No. Image palette extraction runs on a local canvas in your browser; the file never leaves your device.

Do I need an account or API key? No. The core tools are fully client-side. The optional AI palette suggestion uses a keyless in-browser provider.

Does it work offline? The core tools (pick, convert, palettes, gradient, contrast, extract) work offline once installed as a PWA. AI palette suggestions need a network connection.

What color spaces are supported? hex, rgb, hsl, and oklch for conversion; oklch, oklab, hsl, and srgb for gradient interpolation.

## Tech

- Astro (static output)
- React 19 islands
- Tailwind CSS v4
- culori for color math
- Shared atomic `@chirag127/oz-*` packages: chrome, tokens, AI (g4f), file helpers
- @vite-pwa/astro for PWA / offline
- Deployed on Cloudflare Pages
